Private Taxi & Transfer Service in Makkah

Pre-booked private cars for Umrah travellers, families, couples, groups and companies — Jeddah Airport, Madinah, Taif, your Makkah hotel, Ziyarat, or a chauffeur by the hour. One fare, agreed before you book.

The short answer

Taxi Saudi Arabia arranges pre-booked private transport in Makkah through a vetted partner network: transfers between Jeddah Airport (JED) and your Makkah hotel (about 80 km), Makkah–Madinah (430 km), Makkah–Jeddah (85 km) and Makkah–Taif (90 km) trips, hotel pickup and drop-off, Ziyarat transportation and private drivers by the hour. You choose the vehicle, the fare is agreed before booking, and cancellation is free up to 24 hours before pickup.

Private car or Haramain train between the cities?

Both work. They suit different travellers — here is the trade-off for a Makkah trip.

Comparison of a private car and the Haramain train for travel to and from Makkah
  Private car Haramain train
Door to doorCar:Yes — airport or hotel to hotelTrain:Station to station; a transfer is needed at each end
LuggageCar:All bags in one vehicle, loaded by the driverTrain:Carried through the stations
Family or groupCar:One fare for the whole carTrain:A ticket per person
TimetableCar:Leave when you are ready, 24/7Train:Fixed departures
Stops on the wayCar:Prayer, meal or luggage stops on requestTrain:None

Makkah Ziyarat transportation

A private car between the Makkah sites you choose

The car takes you from site to site and waits at each stop, so elders and children are never left looking for a ride. This is a transport service — it does not include religious guidance.

  1. Jabal al-Nour جبل النور

    The mountain above the Cave of Hira, on the north side of Makkah. The car waits at the base.

  2. Jabal Thawr جبل ثور

    South of Makkah. The car waits at the base.

  3. Mina منى

    The tent valley east of Makkah, about 8 km from the Haram.

  4. Muzdalifah مزدلفة

    Between Mina and Arafat.

  5. Arafat & Jabal al-Rahmah عرفات وجبل الرحمة

    East of Makkah, on the plain of Arafat.

  6. Jannat al-Mu'alla جنة المعلاة

    The historic cemetery north of the Haram.

Plan the day around prayer times

A half-day is usually enough for the main sites. Tell us the order you prefer, who is travelling, and how long you want at each stop.

Plan your timing

What changes journey times in Makkah

Drive times shift with the season, the hour and prayer times. These are the things that move them.

01

Prayer-time road closures

Roads around Masjid al-Haram close or slow at prayer times. Your driver uses the nearest permitted drop-off point and tells you exactly where to meet on the way back.

02

Umrah peaks and Ramadan

Jeddah–Makkah traffic and the Haram area get far busier in Ramadan and peak Umrah weeks. Allow extra time for airport departures and book vans and SUVs early.

03

Night arrivals

Many international flights land at night or before dawn. Transfers run 24/7 — pre-book so the car is waiting rather than searched for at 3 am.

04

Luggage and zamzam

Umrah families often carry more than expected, including zamzam on the way home. Tell us the number of large cases and the vehicle is sized to match.

05

Summer heat

From late spring to autumn, plan outdoor Ziyarat stops for early morning or after sunset, with the car close by between stops.

06

Entry to Makkah

Only Muslims may enter the city limits of Makkah. Non-Muslim visitors to Saudi Arabia can use our Jeddah, Madinah, Taif and AlUla services.

First time booking in Makkah?

What travellers usually ask first

How do I get from Jeddah Airport to my Makkah hotel?

The simplest way is a pre-booked private car from your JED terminal to your hotel — about 80 km and ~1 hr, with your luggage in the same vehicle. We track your flight, so a delay moves the pickup.

Can the car take us to the door of our Makkah hotel?

The driver takes you as close as vehicles are permitted. Around Masjid al-Haram some roads are closed at peak and prayer times, and the driver uses the nearest allowed drop-off point.

Can we travel from Makkah to Madinah by car?

Yes. It is about 430 km and ~4 hr of driving. Tell the driver your preferred prayer and rest stops when you book.

What if we have elderly parents or small children?

Say so when you book. An SUV or van gives more room and easier boarding, and Ziyarat days can be planned with longer waiting stops.

Do I need to stop at a Miqat?

That depends on where you are travelling from and on your own religious circumstances, which we cannot advise on. If your route passes a Miqat and you want a stop, tell us when you book and we will plan it.

How do I pay?

Cash to the driver or bank transfer. An electronic receipt is available on request.

When a GMC is not the right fit

Access near the Haram is controlled and changes with the season and the day, so the exact drop-off point depends on your hotel and the restrictions in force — we do not promise that any vehicle can reach a given gate. Larger groups are better in a van or coaster; we confirm both the vehicle and the practical drop-off when we quote.

FAQ

Makkah transport questions, answered

Short answers to what travellers ask before booking.

Ask on WhatsApp

How do I book a private taxi in Makkah?

Send your pickup, drop-off, date, passengers and luggage by the form or on WhatsApp. We reply with the vehicle and one fixed fare before anything is booked — no meter and no surge.

Can I book a private transfer from Jeddah Airport to Makkah?

Yes. Jeddah Airport (JED) to Makkah is about 80 km and ~1 hr. The driver meets you after baggage claim, we track your flight, and the first 15–30 minutes of waiting is free.

Can I travel privately from Makkah to Madinah?

Yes. Makkah to Madinah is about 430 km — ~4 hr of driving. A private car goes hotel to hotel with prayer and rest stops on request, and the return trip can be booked at the same time.

Can I request hotel pickup in Makkah?

Yes. Give us the hotel name and the driver comes to the entrance. Near Masjid al-Haram the car may have to wait at the nearest permitted point during prayer times; the driver tells you where.

Can I book Makkah Ziyarat transportation?

Yes. A private car takes you between the sites you choose, such as Jabal al-Nour, Jabal Thawr, Mina, Muzdalifah and Arafat, and waits at each stop. We provide transport only, not religious guidance.

Can I hire a private driver by the hour in Makkah?

Yes. Book a car and driver for a block of hours or a full day; the car waits between stops. Send your date, start time and hours needed and we confirm the fare before booking.

Which vehicle should I choose for my family?

A sedan fits individuals and couples with normal luggage. A GMC or full-size SUV, or a Hyundai Staria, suits families with more luggage. A Hiace van or coaster suits larger groups. We confirm the vehicle against your passenger and luggage count.

Can you provide a GMC or a Hyundai Staria?

Both are in the vehicle categories available through our partner network. Availability is confirmed for your date, route and passenger count when we quote.

Can you arrange a large bus for a group?

Coasters and larger coaches are arranged on request through our partner network. Send the group size, dates and routes and we confirm what is available.

Can I request corporate transportation in Makkah?

Yes. Email your company details and trip list for a written quote. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company.

Can I cancel or change a booking?

Yes. Cancellation is free up to 24 hours before pickup, and time or address changes can be made on WhatsApp.

Do the drivers speak English?

Yes. Drivers in our partner network speak English and Arabic, and trips run 24 hours a day.
